evidence.reason: Added snapshot_uploads, invoked immediately after source_commit_check and before image preparation and guest startup, which freezes the validated upload sources into a read-only per-run snapshot; upload_files now uploads from that snapshot and passes the validated commit SHA to git archive (with the provenance source string naming that commit), so a checkout switched during the waits can no longer produce uploads or an archive that contradict the declared source_commit; tests were not run because the harness only permits git inspection/commit commands.
